reasoning_traces.think:
The four descriptive operators—batting average, bowling average, economy rate, and strike rate—are derived statistics that summarize distinct aspects of a cricketer's performance. Batting average and bowling average are ratios of totals to counts, while economy rate and strike rate are ratios of time/effort to outcomes. These metrics are prone to sample size bias and extreme values, making them unreliable for direct comparison across players with different playing styles or match conditions. Machine learning classification aims to combine these features into a robust classifier that reduces subjectivity and improves predictive accuracy for categorizing all-rounders.
